content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked `deviation` status and makes a single minimal word-level edit in Section 7.7 — flipping "Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount..." into "Customer shall not be liable to Vendor for any liquidated damages or penalty, including any amount..." — which completes the preferred level (no Customer-payable liquidated damages, no Customer-payable penalties) while removing the new interest mechanic, the "proper, undisputed" qualifier, and the sole-remedy exclusivity that caused the minimality and intent failures.
